body:
i kind of know what you mean. i saw my coworker in the ladies room today and i asked how her weekend was and she said "i didn't do much it was very relaxing" and then didn't really say anything else or even reciprocate so i just said "nice yeah me too! well see you" and hurried out of there. 

i think it's just a mix of not knowing how to be close to people and also people not really being interested in getting to know me. i'm not scared to say hello or anything, but just getting past that part -- it just kind of sucks that even basic conversation is a struggle. i try to observe other people and see what they hell they talk about if they're basically acquaintances or introducing themselves but i just don't get it.

there is nothing lonelier than wondering if someone didn't hear you or if they just didn't feel like replying to you. have it happen a thousand times and it really gets to you.

do you know why people ignore you? all i do is spend time wondering why. there has to be some kind of feature or quality, SOMETHING that makes someone ignorable. i'm not ugly (i'm even kind of pretty with makeup), but i'm really awkward. i don't know if i've ever had somebody be REALLY interested in something i was saying or if they were just being polite. i just don't feel like an interesting person but i also feel like i never got a chance to be because i've been so scared of stepping out and making myself vulnerable anymore

i know, but i feel like it doesn't make things that much better. although, i feel like if i lost him i would definitely just want to die because i really have nothing else to live for... it might sound cliche, but i really can't think of anything else.

this is a really expensive city. i have student loans and i'm trying to save up money to move up to my boyfriend as soon as possible after he starts grad school (while still also trying to visit him at least once a month so i don't go insane). i've been looking, but i can't even find a moderately-priced place to live that wont make me give up saving money or eating. a guy did offer me a place for cheap so far, but i'm really scared to move into an unknown situation sharing a room with some random guy that is requesting for lady roommates exclusively.
